headline: Germany Signals Possible Sanctions Relief for Russia in Exchange for Peace Talks
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz signaled that Western allies could consider gradually lifting economic sanctions against Russia if Moscow commits to peace talks and territorial compromises in Ukraine.
why: Sanctions policies on Russian commodities and banking heavily affect European energy supply logistics and global financial trade flows.

impacts.name: Germany
impacts.why: German political leadership floated conditional sanctions relief tied to peace negotiations in Ukraine.
